Package Utils

Class CommandTest

java.lang.Object
Utils.CommandTest
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CommandTest extends Object implements Serializable
The CommandTest class contains test cases for the Command class. It ensures that the command parsing and extraction methods work correctly.
